Acme's net balance is 40355. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Refunds match Alpha's report. Acme (40355) and birch (40935) are retrieved; cobalt's net balance is still needed before recording any payouts.
The refunds table matches Alpha's report exactly, and I have net balances for all three customers. Recording acme's payout of 40355 cents first.

Acme's payout is recorded. Its net balance matches the orders (4834 + 35521 = 40355), and the refunds table matched Alpha's report. Next I'll record birch's payout of 40935 cents, which matches its orders less refund 294 (36109 + 15074 - 10248 = 40935).
Cobalt's net balance is 25715. Its orders (9909 + 27790 = 37699) less refunds 292 (2929) and 295 (9055) give 25715, so it matches. Recording cobalt's payout now.
All three payouts were recorded successfully. Each net balance matches its orders minus refunds, and the refunds table matched Alpha's report before any payout.
